The person behind the purpose✳

A future in medicine.
A commitment to people.

I’m a 600-level medical student at the University of Ilorin, Nigeria. My journey is shaped by academic curiosity, a commitment to service, and the belief that everyone deserves the knowledge and opportunity to live a healthier life.

Beyond the classroom, I’ve gained experience coordinating community outreaches and promoting health education. My particular interest lies in sexual and reproductive health, and in reaching communities too often left out of the conversation.

“The kind of impact I hope to make begins with showing up.”

Learning finds its purpose when it reaches people. A glimpse into the communities, conversations, and experiences shaping my journey.
